_example_notice: DEMONSTRATION ONLY - NOT EXECUTED OR APPROVED. Replace placeholders with non-sensitive project evidence. This example intentionally fails validation. It grants no authority, credentials, deployment, or acceptance.
_contract_notice: Schema 2 checks local evidence consistency only. Run IDs, timestamps, named owners and authority references are declarations, not proof of execution, identity, legitimacy or lifecycle readiness. --require-v2 rejects legacy schema 1.
_scope_notice: Requirements default to disposition in_scope and need a passed stage-applicable check. For disposition removed/not_applicable use reason, scope_or_policy_ref and decision_artifact {path,sha256}; check_ids may then be empty. A check marked not_applicable needs reason plus scope_or_policy_ref. A reason alone cannot waive scope.
_reuse_notice: A passed check requires explicit run_revision and origin executed/reused. Executed requires run_id and timezone-qualified ISO executed_at; reused requires reuse_reason. Deliberate historical document reuse uses fresh_required:false. Stage-required fresh checks and deployed smoke must declare current executed runs. Values do not prove reality.
_timing_notice: This planned preflight keeps the future deployment smoke applicable only to observation; it is not a completed check required for predeployment authorization. After an authorized actual deployment, add release to SMOKE-EXAMPLE.required_for and provide real current executed target smoke evidence before validating release.status deployed. A consistent planned record does not mean deployment or launch occurred.

requirements.description: Replace with an accepted observable requirement and its stage-specific checks.

business_acceptance._delegation_notice: For method delegated additionally provide explicit authority_ref and digest-bound authority_artifact. Agent output cannot supply its own authority. Scoped not_applicable instead requires reason, scope_or_policy_ref and decision_artifact, still bound to revision.

operations_handoff._scope_notice: For applicable:false use reason, scope_or_policy_ref and decision_artifact, still bound to revision; a missing owner is not an exemption.
